release.alarm_rule: an alarm withholds the confirmatory release until a documented review by Johann/Astra, referenced in a separate addendum; never an automatic rerun; computed p-values stay as a NOT released evaluation

diagnostics.rule: statistical cross-checks at 4 SE, not proofs; an alarm withholds the confirmatory release pending a documented review; no repetition until passing

conventions.loss: acc(c0) - acc(c), positive = worse than c0
conventions.delta_G: seed intervals conditional on the stored B values; the MC-SE of delta_B is reported alongside
conventions.lda_split: relative to the condition-specific POPULATION LDA (the LDA criterion), not to the best linear rule; the second term includes the finite estimation of the fixed model
conventions.mlp: delta_G of the MLP mixes model class, mismatch, finite data and optimisation/regularisation; not attributed to a cause
conventions.lda_decomposition_uses: exact population accuracy of the fixed LDA rule

confirmatory.question: Is the fixed MLP better than the fixed LDA by more than delta at the two raised endpoints?
confirmatory.not_tested: neither non-inferiority to c0 nor the preservation of the size of the base advantage
